issue_request: FHIR-8810 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the Subscription resource raised against DSTU1 and applied for DSTU2. It asked that a Subscription channel type example using "webSocket" be corrected to the lowercase code "websocket".
initial_application: The issue was historically applied before this reconciliation. Jira comments say it was already fixed, and commit 824bc478de9f4c6f5c25b27f24671eadb2613dfd changed source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml from "webSocket" to "websocket" in the Subscription channel type example.
additional_context: Subscription remains an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative Subscription source now uses Subscription.channelType and shows the core websocket channel in lowercase in the introduction, notes, workflow source, and StructureDefinition comments. The only current source hits for the old camel-case "webSocket" spelling are in source/subscription/josh proposal.txt, a historical proposal note not referenced by current source includes or build configuration.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current build-facing Subscription source needs correction.
